description: Sixteen-step trigger sequencer built from four 4-step patterns played one after another, each pattern a whole number from 0 to 15 whose four bits are its four steps

params.text: Chooses the four-step pattern for that section as a number from 0 to 15, the bits of the number being the steps that carry a trigger
Attenuverter over that section's pattern CV, from fully inverted through nothing to full; the result is added to the number set by the SELECT knob

inputs.text: Each rising edge above 2V moves the sequence on one step
A rising edge above 2V restarts the sequence at its first step on the next clock pulse
A gate above 2V lets the sequencer run and a level below 0.1V holds it; with nothing patched the sequencer runs
Shifts that section's pattern number, by an amount set by that section's CV knob; at a full attenuverter setting 10V covers all sixteen patterns

outputs.text: Carries the sixteen-step sequence, 10V on each step whose bit is set; the output mode menu makes those clock-width pulses, gates lasting the whole step, or 1ms triggers

menu: Output mode — sets the output to Clocks, Gates or Triggers
Add CV expander — places an Octet Trigger Sequencer CV Expander to the right of this module
Add gate expander — places an Octet Trigger Sequencer Gate Expander to the right of this module

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
